## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-api` 技能里流程入口 `400 FLOW_FAILED` 一段,原文把 `details.innerRefusal` 说成「节点的写入被拒」并只列三个错误码;现改为「节点遇到的拒绝」(数据节点的读或写、`script` 节点的函数名),错误码改为举例并补上 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`。另在「`apis:` 还是代码处理器」表格的 `script` 行加一个链接,指向 automation 技能里讲「到底运行哪个函数」的条目,不复述。
- 为什么改:自 PR #32257 起,`script` 节点的函数名在本包范围内有歧义或只在依赖闭包外,流程入口答 `400 FLOW_FAILED`,`innerRefusal.code` 为 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`;按旧文按错误码分支的客户端会漏掉它。
- 风险与回滚:纯技能文字,`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` 改 5 行、净增 1 行,外加一个 changeset;不动 schema、不动运行时;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` 第 360–363 行(innerRefusal 句),再看第 133 行(表格链接)。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- skills/`,预期只见上述两处:innerRefusal 句改为「a node met」并举 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`,表格 `script` 行多一个指向 objectstack-automation「Valid-but-silently-wrong」第 3 条的链接。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`skills/**`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` lines 360–363**, the flow-door paragraph. `innerRefusal?` was "the `{ code, message }` a node's write was refused with, `code` in its wire spelling (`UNIQUE_VIOLATION`, `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`)". It now reads "the `{ code, message }` refusal a node met (a data node's read or write, a `script` node's function name), `code` an `ErrorCode` member in wire spelling (e.g. `UNIQUE_VIOLATION`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`)". The codes are examples now, not a set.
- **`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` line 133**, the "Choosing between `apis:` and a code handler" table. The `script` node row gains one link, "which one runs: [objectstack-automation](../objectstack-automation/SKILL.md#valid-but-silently-wrong-passes-build-fails-at-runtime) item 3", and restates nothing.
- **`.changeset/32379-api-flow-inner-refusal-any-node.md`**: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, carrying both declaration lines.

This resumes the released commit `ab838308` (branch `claude/project-thread-xb2225`, Release comment 6807417751) and merges `origin/main` `6538ba48`. Every claim the commit makes was re-read on that `main` (below); none moved, so the text is unchanged.

## Why

Each claim, read on `origin/main` `6538ba48`:

- **A `script` node's function-name refusal fills `innerRefusal` with `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`.** `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/screen-nodes.ts:651-660`: when `engine.resolveFunction` throws a package-scoped refusal, the node returns `code: 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'` plus `refusalCarriedBy(err)`. Pinned at the flow door by `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-request-family.dogfood.test.ts:280-298` (`[400, 'FLOW_FAILED']`, `details.innerRefusal.code === 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'`) and in-engine by `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-function-package-scope.test.ts:134` (both from PR #32257).
- **A data node's read fills it too, not only a write.** `refusalCarriedBy` is called by all four data-node catch arms in `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/crud-nodes.ts` (`get_record` :669, and :831, :947, :1026 for the three writes). It carries any declared 4xx throw (`inner-refusal.ts:86-102`).
- **`code` is an `ErrorCode` member.** `FlowInnerRefusalSchema.code` is `ErrorCode` (`packages/spec/src/api/automation-api.zod.ts:361-366`).
- **The link target exists.** `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:230` is the heading `## Valid-but-silently-wrong (passes build, fails at runtime)`, and item 3 (`:262-275`) states the package rule for which function a `script` node runs (landed in PR #32377). The anchor follows the form `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:221` already uses for another heading in that skill.

## Acceptance notes

- `skills/` sweep (`git grep` for `innerRefusal` and `FLOW_FAILED`): this paragraph is the only skill text that teaches `innerRefusal`. No `evals/*.json` mentions it, so no eval was made false.
- Not in scope, noted only: the spec's own `.describe` on `FlowFailureDetailsSchema.innerRefusal` (`packages/spec/src/api/automation-api.zod.ts:640-642`, mirrored in `content/docs/references/api/automation-api.mdx:389` and `:1140`) still says "the refusal a node's write met". It is spec prose, outside this card's surface (carrier: none).
